about: Exact, enumerated differences permitted between the historical golden snapshots and the current engine. compare-snapshots.js applies them to its in-memory copy of the expected file only; the snapshot files are never changed. Every listed change must match exactly (order, column, original text) or the comparison fails; any difference not listed still fails.
approval: Owner decision D1 (option A), 16 Nov 2026: retain the historical golden snapshots and enumerate the 20 permitted N1 changes. Implemented and technically verified by Claude; not yet formally accepted (Stage 3 open).

changes.reason: N1: a negative delay means the order is short on recorded supply but a new order placed today arrives 6 days before the planned start; the shortage stays visible (status "Material shortage" unchanged) and the delay no longer shows a negative number
